decisions.reason: Replacing five tables does not alter the fixed section order or permission to reorder sections.
The source addresses replacement tables and does not change the biography count, affiliation, or placeholder method.
The organization chart remains required in the final draft and is unaffected by replacement of the tables.
The complete final draft remains the content basis; replacing particular tables does not change this general inclusion requirement.
The source changes table assets only and does not affect photo placement, source, or mandatory selection rules.
Table replacement occurs within the existing layout task but does not change full-document coverage or the number of layout passes.
The source does not change or question the 34-page maximum.
Replacing tables from a linked document does not alter the Blue Mesa brand identity or required brand elements.
The source requests replacement of tables in the current proposal and does not resume or modify the deferred reusable-template requirement.
The final PDF format, count, email submission method, and export requirements remain unchanged.
The table replacement request does not alter the requirement that proposal hyperlinks remain functional in the final file.
The source does not change the font-type or font-size consistency rules.
